description: AI-agent-optimized companion CLI for cmux: persisted SQLite state, FTS5 cross-surface search, and a notify-driven event stream that replaces capture-pane polling.

tools.name: buffers_list
tools.description: List cmux paste buffers (the named text registers populated by yank/paste-buffer in any pane). Takes no parameters. Returns an array of objects with name and text. Use this when an agent needs to read back what was copied in a session — for example, to recover a command, snippet, or selection a user yanked into a buffer without re-prompting them.

tools.name: capabilities_list
tools.description: List every RPC method the running cmux exposes. Returns array of Capability.

tools.name: hooks_list
tools.description: List the event hooks configured in cmux. Takes no parameters. Returns an array of objects with event (the cmux event name, e.g., 'window-renamed') and command (the shell command cmux runs when that event fires). Use this to inspect or audit what side effects cmux will trigger on lifecycle events before changing workspace/window state.

tools.name: logs_list
tools.description: List sidebar log entries for a workspace. Optional: workspace, limit. Returns array of LogEntry.

tools.name: notifications_list
tools.description: List notifications across all workspaces. Use --json for the full payload, or filter on workspace_id. Returns array of Notification.

tools.name: panes_list
tools.description: List panes in a workspace. Optional: workspace. Returns array of Pane.

tools.name: status_list
tools.description: List status entries for a workspace. Optional: workspace. Returns array of StatusEntry.

tools.name: surfaces_health
tools.description: Surface health: which surfaces are stranded (not in any window). Optional: workspace. Returns array of SurfaceHealth.

tools.name: surfaces_list
tools.description: List surfaces, optionally scoped to a workspace. Optional: workspace. Returns array of Surface.

tools.name: windows_current
tools.description: Show the currently focused top-level cmux window. Takes no parameters. Returns one Window object: id, index, workspace_count, and selected_workspace_id (the workspace currently selected inside that window). Use this when an agent needs to anchor an action against the user's active window — for example, before invoking workspaces_get on selected_workspace_id, or to confirm which window a subsequent surface-switch will affect.

tools.name: windows_list
tools.description: List all cmux windows. Returns array of Window.

tools.name: workspaces_current
tools.description: Show the currently selected workspace. Returns the Workspace.

tools.name: workspaces_get
tools.description: Get a single workspace with sidebar metadata (cwd, branch, pr). Required: workspace_id. Returns the Workspace.

tools.name: workspaces_list
tools.description: List every cmux workspace (logical pane group). Takes no parameters. Returns an array of Workspace objects: id, ref (e.g., 'workspace:6'), title, index, selected, pinned, cwd, and git_branch. Use this to enumerate workspaces by attribute (title contains, cwd matches, git_branch equals) before drilling in with workspaces_get or workspaces_card; prefer workspaces_current when you only need the active one.
